selection: All git-tracked files under src/ ending .cs, .cshtml, .razor, or .csproj, plus root LICENSE, Directory.Packages.props, eShopOnWeb.sln, and global.json.
normalization: Decode UTF-8 without removing BOMs, replace CRLF with LF, and append a final LF if missing. Nineteen files differ only by this normalization; no code or other text edits.
license: MIT, .NET Foundation and Contributors; original LICENSE and source notices retained.
digest_algorithm: SHA-256 over files sorted by POSIX path relative to src: UTF-8 path + NUL + raw SHA-256(file bytes).
